Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single square raster app launch artwork for a dense, phone-home-screen-like app catalog, displayed at 72–128px.
Primary request: An open cream sketchbook with two tiny watercolor castle towers facing each other and a small pencil-drawn cannon. The pencil-and-watercolor battle has become a tangible miniature.
Scene/backdrop: Warm saturated dark coral / terracotta backdrop. Full-bleed square background.
Style/medium: cohesive polished tactile 3D miniature / editorial icon family; soft studio highlights, high contrast, rich saturated color, crisp silhouette, subtle physical material texture.
Composition/framing: one bold instantly identifiable central motif, large within the square; simple compact composition readable at tiny app-icon size. Keep every object and essential detail inside safe 12% margins on all four edges.
Color palette: Cream paper, soft watercolor castle colors, dark graphite detail and coral/terracotta.
Constraints: exactly one separate square artwork. No lettering, text, labels, logos, watermark, user interface, phone frame, surrounding rounded-square border, contact sheet, grid of icons, or multi-panel arrangement. Do not add unrelated objects. The website CSS will round the square image corners.
